sobre.en:
I'm Igor Romana, a motion designer and editor based in São Paulo. I studied graphic design at Belas Artes and have spent over ten years animating and cutting in agencies and production companies. With the agency Cappuccino, I animate and edit for Carrefour, Ajinomoto, Blowtex and Universal. Before that, I worked on campaigns for Globo, Samsung, Jack Daniel's, Budweiser, Decathlon, AXA Seguros and Banco Santander, and on films for Neve and Gloob.

I start on paper and think about the whole pipeline. I've drawn since I was six, and because I animate and edit, I draw already knowing how a frame will move and where it will be cut. Outside client work I paint, and I've shown in group exhibitions in São Paulo. Years behind a drum kit gave me discipline and an ear for timing.

I work remotely on GMT-3, which overlaps well with Europe and the Americas. Send your brief, deadline and budget through Get a quote, and I'll reply within one working day.
